label: Link Options
description: Set how long the links handed out for a stored file live: every link made from the file this emits (a Reply's answer, a provider's input, a script's link) works for `minutes`. Stores nothing and changes no file: it emits the same file with the new setting. A link to a stored file is always a download (opening it saves the file), and an image, a video or an audio element shows or plays it as usual.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: A stored file, of any kind.

inputs.name: minutes
inputs.label: Links live (minutes)
inputs.description: How long each link made from this file works, 1 minute to 7 days (10080). Empty: the default, 15 minutes.

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: The same file, its links living `minutes`. The same kind that came in: a Video stays a Video.
